name: Krolg
summary: Krolg is an uncorrupted furbolg living in an isolated hut south of Mystral Lake in Ashenvale. Formerly a member of the Foulweald tribe, he has broken away from his kin who fell to demonic madness and will only speak with those who appear to him in furbolg form.

sections.title: A Mind Unbroken
sections.body: While most of the Foulweald furbolgs in Ashenvale have succumbed to the demonic taint left behind by the Burning Legion, Krolg remains lucid and untouched by madness. Residing in a secluded shelter south of Mystral Lake, he keeps a cautious vigil over the forest. Having witnessed the tragic descent of his brethren into senseless violence, he refuses to interact with outsiders at face value, speaking only with beings that appear as kin.

sections.title: Dartol's Legacy
sections.body: Through the magical enchantment of Dartol's Rod of Transformation, Alliance travelers are able to cloak themselves in the guise of a furbolg. Upon seeing what appears to be a friendly kindred spirit, Krolg opens up and reveals crucial insights into cleansing the land. He directs heroes against Ran Bloodtooth and his guards, whose corruption and hatred threaten the forest.

faq.q: Why won't Krolg talk to me?
faq.answer: Krolg is deeply suspicious of outsiders and terrified of the violent chaos consuming the forest. He will completely ignore you unless you are under the furbolg transformation granted by Dartol's Rod of Transformation during the Raene's Cleansing questline.
He lives in a small shelter known as Krolg's Hut, situated just south of Mystral Lake in south-central Ashenvale.

faq.q: What tribe does Krolg belong to?
faq.answer: Krolg was originally part of the Foulweald tribe. Unlike the rest of his kin, who fell to corruption and demonic frenzy, he maintained his sanity and severed ties with them.
Krolg attacks outsiders who approach him without using the furbolg transformation. Adventurers must use Dartol's Rod of Transformation before approaching him.

faq.q: Why does Krolg want Ran Bloodtooth dead?
faq.answer: Krolg sees Ran Bloodtooth as power-hungry and made stronger by corruption. Although Krolg blames the night elves for his kin's suffering, he will not let Ran threaten their children or the forest's other creatures.

faq.q: Who was Dartol, whose rod lets adventurers speak with Krolg?
faq.answer: Dartol created the enchanted Rod of Transformation, which lets its bearer take furbolg form. Adventurers use the already-restored rod to approach Krolg during Raene's Cleansing.

angles.text: For the night elves of Astranaar, Krolg represents a bittersweet reminder of their ancient furbolg allies before demonic corruption shattered the tribes.
Druids seeking to restore balance to Ashenvale find an invaluable, lucid voice in Krolg amidst a landscape overrun by tainted wildlife.
Alliance scouts assisting Raene Wolfrunner rely on Krolg to dismantle the leadership of the hostile Foulweald furbolgs.
